note: tester.34 release manifest: every row moves to the tester.34 integration head of its line (bc250-win, vkd3d-proton, dxvk and the seven Mesa lines). Row bases are the tester.33 row commits, so that the attribution scan reads exactly the commits that are new since tester.33. New row tests: app-options and cache-quota on the dxvk rows, cache-policy on the engine12 rows. Respin: the KMD rows (start witness after an S1 refusal) and the control app rows (BD-257 guard reset texts) move to b1afec48; every other row keeps its build. Respin 2: the KMD rows moved to d1f61f56, the merge of the GitHub #45 DP link fix (HBR2 and HBR3 training, DP modes above 300 MHz with fallback).

outputs.pair_skew: The x86 system Vulkan row 53ccb05f is the tester.33 wow64 line 20d7c8c9 with the BD-254 preamble and gather-slot fixes (cbe8dc03, f9191318, 771c666b) and the fixes it shares with the x64 system row d12fb4fd (tester.33 line ad130cc2): driconf regular expressions on Windows, the process name at any path length, machine-profile driconf files, the per-application graphics settings, no GDS access without a GDS partition (BD-119), debugging variables read only in the lab flavour and the zstd 1.5.7 wrap. Only the x86 row reads MemoryOverflow and the WSI route switch in the 64-bit registry view (the x64 row reads that view natively). Only the x64 row has the compute-node border colour fix (3a5e0436); the x64 row gets the instruction-prefetch padding (e92476c8) that the x86 line has had since before tester.33 (b3e45baf). The x86 settings reader uses the GDI-only WSI: MaxFrameLatency applies only to other GPUs on the DXGI path, and VSync 0 only skips the DWM wait. The x86 build does not port the x64 DXGI present or compute work.
